correctness.rationale: The primary structure supplies a homogeneous strongly dense ordered 2-regular C-set and proves that its M_3 reduct is set-homogeneous with the same automorphism group. The reduced finite ordered binary-tree shape is a complete orbit invariant and all shapes occur. At a root split (a,b), the only cross-root edges have one left and two right leaves, giving exactly a*binom(b,2) new edges. The weighted Catalan recurrence follows by independent recursive subtrees; mirroring complements all triples. A bundled checker independently computes edge sets for all plane shapes through 9 leaves, recurrences through 11, and all permutation-isomorphism classes through 6. The n=6 coefficient vector is everywhere positive; singleton-root grafting embeds [0,binom(n-1,3)] and its translate by binom(n-1,2), which overlap at every n>=7, so the size-five missing middle is the sole gap in any order.

value.rationale: The coefficient polynomial completely classifies hyperedge frequencies among finite induced isomorphism types of a canonical set-homogeneous but nonhomogeneous 3-hypergraph. It yields a natural all-arity structural invariant with a nontrivial five-point exclusion, not just an unmotivated finite computation. The paper specifically uses root cones to analyze ages, making the refinement mathematically directed. The sharp all-order edge-count support theorem gives a substantive structural completeness statement rather than a bare small-order anomaly.
